summary: Plot library in the root base package: scales (band, linear, ordinal, point), shapes (arc, area, bar, line, pie, radial line, stack, sankey), axis, grid, label, hover readers, path cache, plot element and the appear animation with PlotAppearScope; the Plot theme field and defaults.

implementation.history: First worker died at the 2026-10-22 usage-limit stop with 56/67 tests; a fresh worker (2026-10-23) added the 11 appear.rs tests, fixed NaN-min semantics in band scale (rustMinF32), corrected upstream line citations, and audited every plot file against upstream.

tests.per_module: scales 25, sankey 12, stack/pie/arc 7, line/radial 3, grid/axis/path_cache 8, hover 1, appear 11 (8 window on the virtual clock, 3 pure)

orchestrator_rerun.where: git checkout-index snapshot of HEAD 66a7b55 + ticket-31 files only (20 and 28 in-progress files excluded)
orchestrator_rerun.command: CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./base && gofmt -l base && go build ./...

deviations: solid fills/strokes only (decision 02: native scene rejects gradients)
optional rust_decimal value type not ported
ShapeKey hashes with maphash instead of DefaultHasher
appear-scope stack per window instead of thread-local
appear memory keyed by GlobalElementID.String() (Go ID type is not comparable)
